title: Register update preserves the read frame
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input and let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ work tapes. Suppose $r$ and $s$ are distinct tape indices and the head on tape $r$ is at position $0$. For any state labels $l,l'$, valid input-head position $ip$, natural number $k$, tape content $f:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{none},\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le \operatorname{length}(	ext{binary representation of }|x|+1)$, updating tape $s$ and its head to $f$ and $p$ after the read configuration yields a configuration in the read frame of $c$: the output and other tape contents are preserved, and the heads on tapes $r,s$ lie between $-1$ and that same length, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input list $x$ and a configuration $c$
The head on tape $r$ is at position $0$
An integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le \operatorname{length}(	ext{binary representation of }|x|+1)$
